headline: Weathered Expanse Battle Unabated; Posts Change Hands at Callahan's Passage
war_summary: Fighting in Weathered Expanse ran on through the forenoon, with fresh events logged as late as half past ten and casualties in the past hour reckoned near 250 Colonial against 333 Warden; the day's ledger there now stands about 9,754 and 10,428, and one of its nine bases is counted neutral. At Callahan's Passage, where Warden colours had stood over nine of ten bases, two positions have changed hands, leaving eight Warden and two Colonial, and the guns were still speaking at the noon hour. Mooring County, which carried the heaviest recent tolls, has gone quiet over the past two hours, though its day's total remains close to 9,900 casualties on each side. Palantine Berm, Stlican Shelf and Nevish Line likewise show little new activity. Colonials retain the great majority of the map's bases; Warden colours hold twelve regions entire, with majorities at Callahan's Passage, Mooring County and Nevish Line. Enlistments remain brisk in the contested sectors.
